clips.title: Conversations. Clear terms.
clips.caption: A single workspace for encrypted Chat and confidential RFQs.
clips.label: PRODUCT PREVIEW
clips.narration: Here’s APP twenty. Encrypted conversations and a clearer way to agree on a trade, on Starknet.

clips.title: Set your terms
clips.caption: Choose your amount, minimum return and makers.
clips.label: LIVE ENCRYPTED QUOTE
clips.narration: Start with the trade you want. Set your amount and the minimum you’ll accept. Your request is encrypted for the makers you choose.

clips.title: Review your quote
clips.caption: Separate funding approvals. Encrypted settlement. An independent recovery deadline.
clips.label: LIVE ENCRYPTED QUOTE
clips.narration: Review the quote, fund your side, and approve the swap. Both assets settle as encrypted notes, with a deadline to recover your funds if it doesn’t complete.

clips.title: Keep the conversation encrypted
clips.caption: A confirmed mainnet message, decrypted by its recipient.
clips.label: MAINNET · READ-ONLY
clips.narration: Chat keeps the conversation encrypted, too. This message came from Starknet mainnet and is decrypted here using the recipient’s key.

clips.title: Build with the Node SDK
clips.caption: Independent signing policies for makers and agents.
clips.label: PRODUCT PREVIEW
clips.narration: Makers and agents can join through the Node SDK. Each side keeps control of its own signing policy, from agreeing terms to recovering an expired swap.
